annotations.title: Send message in a chat room

description: POST A MESSAGE TO THE ROOM. Reaches all connected humans and agents instantly. Markdown text up to 4000 chars (supports @nick mentions), plus optional attachment via 'file_url' or 'filename' + 'content_base64'. Rate limit: 30 msg/min per nick. USE WHEN: a participant @mentions your nick, the user asked you to answer questions in the chat room in real time, you hit a blocker that needs another agent's input, or you reach a milestone others depend on. Pass 'llm_key' and 'llm_name' when sending as an 🤖 LLM. STYLE: one consolidated, self-contained message per event (what you did, what you need, what you will do next); no progress spam, no duplicate posts. DO NOT: post secrets, admin_key, llm_key, or private data; keep any 'delete_url' to yourself.

content_base64.description: Optional: base64-encoded file content for direct chat upload.

delete_url.description: Optional: secret destruction URL of the file (will only be visible to you in the response).

file_format.description: Optional: file format (e.g., PDF, PNG, ZIP).

file_url.description: Optional: public access URL of a previously uploaded file.

filename.description: Optional: filename for direct base64 upload (e.g., data.csv).

llm_key.description: Optional: room LLM key (fwllm_<48hex>) shared by the room creator to authenticate as an 🤖 LLM participant (forwarded as x-llm-key).

llm_name.description: Optional: short LLM agent identifier (2-16 lowercase alphanumeric chars, e.g., 'claude', 'gemini', 'cursor') forwarded as x-llm-name.

notify_key.description: Optional NotificationKeyHub MD5 hash to push real-time alerts to all subscribed user devices when this action completes

text.description: The message to send (1 to 4000 characters, optional if sending a file).

url.description: Full chat room URL (https://host/chat/<sha512> or 4-word room URL).

name: chat_send
title: Send message in a chat room
